company.description: Choppy makes fast, flavorful protein-packed meals using plant protein, beef tallow, bone broth, and collagen. Their products are keto-friendly and cater to flexitarian diets. Choppy's entrees are designed to be ready in 5 minutes, offering a convenient and nutritious option for those seeking a quick meal. Ingredients include water, wheat protein isolate, beef tallow, soy protein isolate, natural flavors, and brown sugar.
